MUTE_VOLUME.description: Mutes or unmutes the system volume, or sets volume level with --level 0-100

OPEN_BROWSER.description: Opens the default web browser, accepts optional --url to open a specific website or link

SCREENSHOT.description: Takes a screenshot of the screen and saves it to the Desktop

LIST_FILES.description: Lists files and folders in a directory, accepts --path to specify which directory to list

SYSTEM_INFO.description: Shows current system information including CPU usage, RAM usage, disk usage, and battery status

CLOSE_APP.description: Closes or kills a running application by process name, accepts --name with the app name like notepad, chrome, spotify

SHUTDOWN.description: Shuts down, restarts, or sleeps the computer. Use --action shutdown, restart, or sleep. Optional --delay in seconds

CANCEL_SHUTDOWN.description: Cancels a pending shutdown or restart that was scheduled

GET_TIME.description: Gets and displays the current date and time

TYPE_TEXT.description: Types text at the current cursor position in any window, accepts --text with the text to type

SEARCH_GOOGLE.description: Opens a Google search in the browser for a query, accepts --query with the search term

SET_BRIGHTNESS.description: Sets the screen brightness level, accepts --level 0-100

CREATE_FOLDER.description: Creates a new folder at the specified path, accepts --path with the full directory path

DELETE_FILE.description: Deletes a file or folder at the given path, accepts --path with the full path to delete

PLAY_PAUSE_MEDIA.description: Controls media playback: play, pause, next track, previous track, or stop. Accepts --action play, next, prev, or stop

OPEN_APP.description: Opens any installed application by name, accepts --name with the app name like spotify, chrome, discord, calculator, vlc, steam, word, excel

CLIPBOARD_COPY.description: Copies text to the clipboard, accepts --text with the text to copy

START_OLLLAMA_SERVER.description: Starts the Ollama server. Use this tool to begin Ollama server initialization.

DESCRIBE_SCREEN.description: Use AI (LLaVA vision model) to look at the screen and describe what is visible — open apps, windows, content, errors, buttons. Use when user asks what is on screen, what is open, what does it say, or what do you see. Accepts optional --prompt to ask a specific question about the screen.

READ_SCREEN.description: OCR the screen to extract all visible text — use when user wants to read text on screen, copy an error message, read a document shown on screen, or extract any text that is visible. Accepts optional --region x y width height to read a specific area.

FIND_ON_SCREEN.description: Find a specific text, button, or element on the screen and return its location. Use when user asks where something is on screen or before clicking something. Requires --target with the text or element name to find.

CLICK_ELEMENT.description: Find a button, link, or element on screen by its text or description and click it. Use when user says click, press, or tap something visible on screen. Requires --target with the element name or text. Optional --type left, right, or double.
